text:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGE: cedarbridge private VPC — NLB healthchecks failing, broad 502s from dedicated pool. Paging #oncall-network

alice: oncall-network here, picking up. any customer impact details?

ben: seeing spike in 502s from 10.22.0.0/16 targets, retries amplify latency. Dedicated pool cedarbridge-prod-1 affected.

sam-cs: CedarBridge reports ingestion pipeline errors since 11:40UTC, ticket CB-2026-112. They say uploads slow, some requests time out. Customer labeled P1.

carlos: quick triage: NLB target group healthcheck failing 503s. ALB targets still healthy. Possible backend SG or healthcheck path regression after deployment.

priya: I'm on the infra console now. Pulling target health history and recent config changes.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/vpc-ingress-egress. Suggested mitigations: 1) shift weight to ALB 2) adjust NLB healthcheck path 3) temporary SG open to control plane.

emilie: curl from inside VPC to healthcheck path returning 502: 
```
curl -I http://10.22.45.12:8080/hc | head -n 5
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
```

ben: agreed. plan: 1) shift traffic off NLB to ALB as quick mitigation, 2) revert last healthcheck change on prod app (deployed 11:37UTC), 3) if traffic still bad, open SG for control-plane health probes (10.0.0.0/8) temporarily.

alice: ben, can you do the ALB weight shift? carlos, can you prep SG rollback commands? priya, hold the deployment revert until we confirm weight shift effect.

ben: starting weight shift now, moving 80% -> ALB, 20% remaining on NLB for monitoring. Using infra UI, will post CLI ops.

carlos: SG changes ready. Command to add control-plane cidr allow to healthcheck port:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.0.0.0/8 --description "temp allow control-plane probes"
```

priya: rolling back healthcheck path in deployment config (reverting bundle 2026-06-11T11:36). Standby.

ben: weight shift done -> observed drop in 502s after ~30s. Metrics: error rate from 18% -> 2% on cedarbridge-prod-1. :thumbsup:

sam-cs: CedarBridge confirmed lower errors, says ingestion resumed. They want postmortem and ETA on permanent fix.

alice: good. keep ALB shift until rollback verified. carlos, hold on SG change unless we see health probes still failing after rollback.

carlos: ack, holding.

priya: rollback applied, awaiting stability check for 5m.

ben: monitoring for 10m, logs show the bad path was expecting tag header that new deploy removed. We'll add regression to predeploy checks.

emilie: I'll open a short incident summary for CedarBridge with timeline and mitigation steps.

ops-runbook-bot: Remember to tag incident with customer cedarbridge and affected component: vpc-private/nlb/healthcheck.

alice: oncall handing back to team. if error creeps back, page me. Closing pager in 20.

sam-cs: updating customer ticket with status and next steps.

ben: 1719001400 - marking controls stable, continuing postmortem offline.
